# Pull Request

## Description

A clear and concise description of what this PR does.

## Type of Change

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (adds functionality)
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] Implementation improvement
- [ ] Refactoring (no functional change)
- [ ] Build/CI changes

## Area

- [ ] Python Module (`src/`)
- [ ] Jupyter Notebook (`notebooks/`)
- [ ] Documentation (`README.md`, `docs/`)
- [ ] Tests (`tests/`)
- [ ] Configuration (`.github/`, `.cursor/`, etc.)

## Changes Made

### Files Changed

- `path/to/file1`
- `path/to/file2`

### Summary

Brief summary of what was changed and why.

## Checklist

### Pre-Submission

- [ ] Code follows PEP 8 (for Python files in `src/`)
- [ ] Type hints and docstrings present in `src/` modules
- [ ] No hardcoded API keys, tokens, or credentials
- [ ] No hardcoded paths (`pathlib` or relative paths)
- [ ] Notebooks run clean (`Kernel → Restart & Run All`)
- [ ] `references/` is unchanged
- [ ] No secrets or sensitive data included
- [ ] Markdown lints cleanly

## Related Issues

Closes #(issue number)
Related to #(issue number)

## Screenshots/Examples (if applicable)

Add screenshots or outputs to help reviewers understand changes.

## Additional Notes

Any additional information for reviewers.
